exclusions.description: Signed-channel publication and promotion require protected CI environments and release credentials.
Replacing or restarting a review broker is a separate ownership-aware deployment action.
Linux ARM64, Android, macOS, iOS, and Windows builds require their declared CI runners.
Physical-device, multi-host, reboot, and real-agent evidence is never inferred from deterministic fixtures.
